# castai_organization_users (Data Source)

Lists users that are members of a Cast AI organization. The API has no email filter and one email can map to several identities (e.g. a password login and an SSO login), so filters are applied client-side and a lookup can return multiple users; pair it with a lifecycle precondition when a single subject id is needed, e.g. for castai_role_bindings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up users by email. The API has no email filter and one email can map to
# several identities (e.g. a password login and an SSO login), so the data
# source is filtered client-side and can return multiple users. scim_active is
# only applied when explicitly set.
data "castai_organization_users" "alice" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  email           = "alice@corp.com"
  scim_active     = true
}

# Use the returned user id as a subject for role bindings. The lifecycle
# precondition fails the plan when the email matches more than one identity.
resource "castai_role_bindings" "alice" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  role_id         = castai_role.viewer.id

  subject {
    kind    = "user"
    user_id = one(data.castai_organization_users.alice.users[*].id)
  }

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = length(data.castai_organization_users.alice.users) == 1
      error_message = "Expected 1 identity for alice@corp.com, got: ${jsonencode(data.castai_organization_users.alice.users)}"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Cast AI organization ID.

### Optional

- `auth_provider` (String) Client-side filter by auth provider label (the SSO connection the identity comes from), exactly as returned in the user payload.
- `email` (String) Client-side, case-insensitive filter by user email. A single email can map to several identities, so this can still match multiple users.
- `include_groups` (Boolean) Server-side flag controlling whether group memberships are fetched and exposed in group_ids. Defaults to true.
- `role_ids` (List of String) Server-side filter by role IDs; only members holding any of the listed roles are returned.
- `scim_active` (Boolean) Client-side filter for users managed by SCIM provisioning. Only an explicitly set value filters; when the attribute is absent from the configuration no filtering happens.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `users` (List of Object) List of users matching the filters, ordered by user ID. Empty when nothing matches; this is not an error. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))
